source_refs.section: The worked design uses AWS; A coordinator must verify the expected corpus; Identity coherence also has to survive distribution

evidence_spans.text: “The worked design uses AWS object storage for intake, staging, release, and quarantine, EventBridge and SQS for dispatch, and a bounded Fargate or Batch worker pool.

“The local release idea carries forward, but the mechanism changes. Workers can complete at different times. A coordinator must verify the expected corpus, write an immutable manifest of output keys and hashes, and switch an active-corpus pointer. Consumers resolve that pointer; they must not infer readiness by listing staged objects.

evidence_spans.text: “Identity coherence also has to survive distribution. Every worker must use the same policy, canonical identity set, algorithm configuration, and collision allocation.
